title.rendered: 10 Key Benefits Of Private Tuition For Students In Dubai

content.rendered:
With private tutoring becoming increasingly popular, it supports students immensely in improving their performance academically. There are many reasons for this arrangement’s rising acceptance & popularity. You can also associate it with its advantages to the learning students. Nevertheless, the sole objective of hiring private tutors is to help & track candidates’ progress faster in school

Children commonly tend to show a lack of interest, dullness, demotivation, & discouragement in their studies. A lack of firmness, in this case, is quite normal & may demand counseling from someone they’re comfortable sharing. Consequently, a private tutor’s job is not only limited to improving a child’s grades but also guiding them in their future choices. Read ahead to know more about such benefits.

Ignite Training Institute is the best IB, IGCSE. A-Levels, & AP tutors in UAE for full educational support. The institution also offers 10+ years of expertise in preparing students for ACT & EmSAT examinations. You must get in touch with top private tutors for sheer academic excellence. 

10 Key Benefits Of Private Tuition For Students 

As per several pieces of research, students who learn under the guidance of private tutors tend to perform better. Owing to such academic progress, here are ten key advantages of taking private tutoring sessions from qualified & experienced tutors. 

1. Personalized Lessons

Offering personalized support & subject lessons as per the student’s needs & abilities is one of the prime benefits of learning from private tutors. It’s not always possible for children to cope with the coursework at school at the same pace. Private tutors solve this problem by helping them learn & adapt at their own pace. This is also directly associated with harnessing the student’s strengths & working on their shortcomings to match their potential. 

2. Flexible & Convenient Timings

Private tutoring is widely accepted because of the flexibility & convenience it offers to parents & students. This is not only in terms of timings but how the lessons can be structured as per the right approach & student’s pace of learning. The right tutor will help you save a lot of time & indulge in thorough foundation training & repeat practice. As a result, this will lead to lasting knowledge, good grades, & offer enough time to focus on extracurriculars as well. 

3. Safe & Positive Environment

One of the biggest concerns of parents nowadays has taken a shift toward a secure & positive learning environment for their children. With private tuitions coming to the rescue, it offers a very safe & friendly habitat to students. This also helps them to put forward their questions & queries without shying away. Furthermore, it helps develop the ample confidence required to succeed in life & put across their viewpoints with conviction. 

4. Academic Support System

With most parents occupied in their daily schedules, it’s not always achievable to support their child’s academic responsibilities. Students require help with their homework, concept training, & test practice. Hiring incredibly experienced private tutors can solve this problem too! A tutor offering undivided attention to a student leads to minimum distractions & maximum effectiveness producing quicker results. 

5. Self-Paced Learning 

Choosing the right tutor for your child can make all the difference in the world. School teachers are generally bound by a time constraint to complete the academic syllabus. It is not possible for them to look after every student’s educational needs independently. As a consequence, students begin to lack behind & are unable to maintain sync with the school’s pace of teaching. Private tutors make it a point to help students excel at their own pace & organize lessons accordingly. 

6. Freedom To Ask Questions

What’s even the point if a student is hesitant to ask questions to a teacher? As a school’s teaching approach is quite different than that of a private tutor. This provides an opportunity for students to ask an end number of questions & set their concepts straight to avoid any sort of confusion. The tutor that best suits the child’s learning style will make sure to make the student comfortable to engage & learn duly. 

7. Better Academic Performance 

One of the prime reasons to let a child learn from a private tutor is for better academic results. More than that, the candidate’s performance is not only limited to good grades but other targets as well. Tutors at Ignite Training Institute offer full educational support & help you prepare for college strategically. They play a key role in making sure that you’re only academically sound but ready to face the real world outside. 

8. Customized Study Material

Relying only on school textbooks is not enough. Going beyond the curriculum’s coursework & learning from customized study material specific to the enrolled curriculum is important. This provides ample chances to practice & prepare for examinations thoroughly. Resources like past papers and unit-wise mock exam sheets can be a great help to develop confidence in a subject matter. This comes with regular practice & recurring assessments. 

9. Improved Confidence 

Amongst many other benefits, high self-confidence tops the list with flying colors. It is a very critical soft skill that is essential for continuous progress. With one-on-one direct interaction with students, they get a chance to learn from their tutor closely. This helps establish a relationship & creates flexibility that allows students to share & express their problems. Consequently leading to problem-solving & increased self-confidence. 

10. Increased Self-Determination

A positive & flexible learning environment topped with personalized lessons tailored as per the student’s requirements is all that is needed. A private tutor’s core job is to fulfill all educational needs & accelerate the learning process. This leads to high self-determination & develops intrinsic motivation to deliver the best. It is this drive that encourages them to work harder for their academic aspirations in life. 

Related: How To Find The Best Coaching Institute In Dubai? 

Best Private Tutor In Dubai For IB, IGCSE, A-levels, & AP

If you’re enrolled in any of the international curriculums like International Baccalaureate (IB), IGCSE, A-Levels, & AP, here’s the best advice for you. Grab a chance to learn from the best private tutors in UAE for full academic support. Here’s why? 

  • Learn from highly qualified curriculum-specific tutors 
  • Study in small groups or one-on-one for the best support
  • Be part of the critical testing & review methodology
  • Prepare thoroughly for all curriculum subject exams 
  • Focus on fundamentals & excellent conceptual training
  • Learn in a result-driven environment with fun sessions
  • Full syllabus coverage based on problem-based learning
  • Regular practice with mock exams, worksheets, & past papers

Amidst the parent’s busy schedules & school’s pace of teaching is not always an ideal situation for students to wrestle on their own. And not to forget, how intimidating it can be at times to follow the curriculum’s coursework. This can also lead to the possibility of shaken foundation & indeed low grades in the school results. 

On that account, Ignite Training Institute is on a core mission to help students pursue their academic aspirations rightly. Students coming to the institution appear for a diagnostic test for assessing the candidate’s current position. Based on the results, a personalized tutoring strategy is put in place for students’ limitless growth. This strategically accounts for a child’s learning pace, current understanding of the subject & overall goals. 

Our team of expert tutors plays a key role in helping students become academically ready. Contact us to know more! 

Related: The Beginner’s GCSE Guide: Everything You Need to Know

FAQs

1. What Are The Advantages Of Studying From A Private Tutor? 

The following are the advantages of studying from a private tutor – 

  • Personalized Lessons
  • Flexible & Convenient Timings
  • Safe & Positive Environment
  • Personal 1-On-1 Attention
  • Self-Paced Learning 
  • Freedom To Ask Questions

2. Which Is The Best Private Tutor In Dubai? 

Ignite Training Institute is the finest private tutor in UAE for international curriculums like IB, IGCSE, A-Levels, & AP. Furthermore, if you’re someone who’s willing to excel in exams like EmSAT & ACT, this institution is the right place for you to learn. Our experienced team of tutors nurtures students in a critical manner & prepares them to become future-ready. 

3. How To Find A Private Tutor In Dubai?

The following is the ideal means to find a private tutor for yourself – 

  • Consider several years of experience
  • Assess reviews/ratings & credibility 
  • Ideal teaching practices & methods
  • Customized study material & resources
  • Anytime academic consultation for students

Takeaway

These were a few of the key benefits of learning from a private tutor. Their roles & responsibilities are not only limited to offering academic assistance but look after students’ overall growth. Tutors at Ignite Training Institute prepare students for the real world by offering well-rounded support. Our proven critical exam strategies help students to learn, excel & pursue their academic goals with confidence.

Get in touch with our expert counselors today!
